== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Blackflame]] family was a powerful dynasty of [[Black dragons|black dragons]] that ruled the [[Blackflame Empire]] for over five hundred years. Known for their overwhelming strength, they once controlled half of the [[Ashwind continent]] and could force entire sects to surrender through sheer might. Their power was derived from a unique [[madra]] known as the [[Path of Black Flame|Blackflame Path]], or the [[Path of Black Flame]]. However, because human bodies are not naturally suited for [[dragon]]-level power, the family suffered a slow decline. The destructive nature of their [[sacred arts]] eroded their physical bodies and mental stability, often leaving them as twisted husks or causing them to lose their reason. This internal decay eventually led to the family's near-extinction and the loss of their empire. Fifty years ago, the [[Naru clan]]—who had long served as the family's loyal administrators—ascended to the [[throne]]. While many members of the family died out decades ago, some descendants and remnants of their influence still exist.}}

== Blackflame ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-03-blackflame|For more than five centuries, the imperial [[Blackflame]] family maintained their empire through the use of unstoppable force. Although they once united and ruled the entire empire, they lost control to the [[Naru]] fifty years ago. This downfall occurred because their [[madra]] consumes their own bodies, nearly causing the family to die out despite the fact that even their [[Copper]]-level children were considered deadly threats. Once an extremely wealthy lineage, the [[Blackflame]] family has now fallen and is defined by their three ancient [[Trials]].}}
